title: Length of Compiled Conditions
statement: For every condition $c$ and branch target $\ell\in\mathbb N$, the compiled condition has length equal to the condition's size. For a comparison $a<b$ this size is $\mathrm{size}(a)+\mathrm{size}(b)+3$, and for an equality test $a=b$ it is $\mathrm{size}(a)+\mathrm{size}(b)+4$.
